reason: My whole salon already runs on WhatsApp on one phone and it works; asking 5 to 10 stylists to take selfies and type every walk-in's number in an English app is a fight I don't want in a normal week. The cash-drawer and cancelled-bill checks do interest me, but not enough to pay ₹4,999 upfront for software my staff may quietly stop using.
objection: Many of my customers won't give their mobile number, so half the reminders, wallet and top-customer reports will be empty, and my stylists will just skip the entry and keep taking cash.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it actually running in another salon of my size nearby, with the setup fee charged only after the free month if my staff are still using it.
